_help: brain-signer config (signer/brain_signer.py). Runs as its own OS user (brainbridge); this file, the signing key, its GitLab token and its identities copy are readable by that user only. pseudonym_salt must equal the app's bridge.json pseudonym_salt. bridge_users: the GitLab account(s) the app posts questions as (the token in the app's bridge.json).
